checks.name: All rebar semantic IDs equal their node names
All component IDs unique throughout GLB
Reversing only IDs reconstructs exact previously audited GLB SHA

method: Reverse only 143 flange-tie IDs and the additional upper erection-bar ID in memory, serialize identically, then compare the entire reconstructed GLB SHA to the independently audited pre-ID-edit file. This proves all other JSON fields and BIN bytes are unchanged.
